title: Exact age
description: Calculate the exact age of a person using Period between two dates.
hints: Get the difference with getYears(), getMonths() and getDays()
solutionExplanation: Period.between() returns the difference between two dates as a Period object. The getYears(), getMonths() and getDays() methods extract the components.

title: Days remaining
description: Calculate the days remaining until a future date using ChronoUnit.
hints: If the date has already passed, the result will be negative
Print an appropriate message according to the days remaining
solutionExplanation: ChronoUnit.DAYS.between() calculates the exact number of days between two dates. It returns a positive value if the final date is later, negative if it is earlier.
expectedOutput:
Today: 2025-07-27
Christmas: 2025-12-25
There are 151 days left until Christmas

title: Event calendar
description: Create a list of events with LocalDateTime, sort them by date and filter the next 7 days.
hints: Sort with Collections.sort() using a custom Comparator
Filter events whose date is between now and 7 days later
solutionExplanation: The dates are parsed with LocalDateTime.parse() and sorted with Collections.sort() using a Comparator. The events are filtered using isBefore() and isAfter() to compare with the 7-day range.

=== All events (sorted) ===
